title: OpenCode streaming: long answers now arrive
eyebrow: pipeline fix · generator and critic through OpenCode · 2026-11-20
subtitle: OpenCode never returned a non-streamed reply that took longer than about 300 s. At reasoning max the hardest card needs longer, so its run timed out five calls in a row and ended with no machine. Streamed, the same card gave the same right machine in 5 of 5 runs, and 59 runs had no timeout.

blocks.title: In plain words
blocks.text: The generator (deepseek-v4.1-flash) and the critic (glm-5.3-flash) run through OpenCode. A request waits for the whole answer, and OpenCode drops any answer that is not back within about 300 s. At reasoning max the model thinks for 12 to 36 thousand tokens on the card cx-goal-many-rules (case W5a), which takes longer than that. So each call waited the SDK's full 600 s and failed, five times, until the run hit its one-hour cap with no machine. Streaming asks for the answer in pieces as it is written. The timeout now bounds the silence between two pieces (120 s), not the whole answer, so a long answer arrives. Nothing else changed: same prompts, models and cards.

items.label: W5a runs at reasoning max that ended with an accepted, right machine
timed-out calls at reasoning max (27 runs before, 13 after)
longest generator call after the fix; two calls over 300 s succeeded (none could before)
runs with a timeout after the fix (13 at max, 46 at high)

items: **Pipeline side, not model side.** The model's answer was fine once it arrived: all five streamed W5a runs gave the same machine text, and the same file trained to judged success 1.0 in 3 of 3 seeds (300 test episodes) as the chain-regression bundle `many-rules-reworded`.

**At reasoning high** the fix changes little, as expected: answers there rarely pass 300 s. 44 of 46 right before (one timeout), 43 of 46 after (no timeout). The three wrong after are model mistakes the streaming does not touch: W5a dropped a stated "then" once, and G6 and W5b read "until opened once" as Absence; the critic missed both.
**The default moved to max.** With long answers working, the project default became reasoning max later the same day (merge `1d99a94`).

sections.intro: `tools/round_table.py` on this entry's run records, scored against the cards on main `78c666c`. Right / wrong: the accepted machine is right or not; no machine: the run ended without one. First right: the first judged candidate was right. Gen over 300 s ok: generator calls longer than 300 s that succeeded. Reasoning max: the largest reasoning-token count of one call.

items: **Before** is the hidden-output-schema round of the same day (its shape fix already in, no streaming): 27 runs at max (26 cases plus W5a) and 46 at high. **After** is the streamed rerun: at max, 8 cases plus W5a five times; at high, all 46 cases once.
**Wrong counts depend on today's cards.** The scorer reads the cards on main, which changed after the before round, so its "wrong 2" at max may reflect later card edits rather than the model.
**The failed W5a run shows 0 s and 0 tokens** because no call returned: the five calls are logged only with their error.

sections.title: The change
sections.intro: One method in `app/src/engines/provider_engines.py`: every OpenCode completion is streamed, then joined into the reply a non-streamed request returns, so no caller changes. Every OpenCode call goes through it: generator and critic, and also the tagger, labeling generator and reviewer.

blocks.text:
# Longest silence allowed between two streamed OpenCode chunks, not a limit on the whole reply.
# Streamed W5a replays at max reasoning (2026-11-20) never went 2 s without a chunk.
OPENCODE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120

def _stream_completion(self, request):
    stream = self._client.chat.completions.create(
        **request,
        reasoning_effort=self.reasoning,
        stream=True,
        stream_options={"include_usage": True},
        timeout=OPENCODE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    )
    try:
        return _joined_completion(stream)   # content, refusal and reasoning text joined; last usage wins
    except httpx2.TimeoutException as error:
        raise APITimeoutError(request=stream.response.request) from error   # stays retryable
    except httpx2.TransportError as error:
        raise APIConnectionError(request=stream.response.request) from error

**Machine:** `graphs/cx-goal-many-rules-w5a.rm` is the `machine` field of `after-max/W5a-r1.json`, drawn as `.svg` and `.html`.

**Scripts:** `tools/round_table.py` and its scorer `arm_stats.py`, `chain_score.py`, `cases.py`, `loopcrit.py`; the local cards they read are in `evidence/cards/`, the benchmark cards come from the checkout named by `CC_ROOT`.
